turns.user_utterance: what's the process for getting a disposable virtual card?

Sure—here’s how to get a disposable virtual card: open the app, go to your cards section (or Card settings), select the option for a disposable/virtual card, and generate it. The card will create a new set of details you can use for one-time payments, and you can generate a new one anytime you need.
